items.q: Does lighting control work in a finished home?
items.a: Yes. Keypads and dimmers take the place of the switches you have, room by room, with the fixtures already in place.

items.q: Do I have to replace my fixtures?
items.a: Most recessed, pendant, and sconce fixtures dim from the new keypads as they are. A few older ones need a new driver or bulb.

items.q: Can I still use the wall switch?
items.a: Yes. The keypad goes where the switch was, and every button is engraved with what it does.

items.q: What happens when the internet goes down?
items.a: The keypads keep working. They talk to the lights directly, not through the internet.

items.q: Can it run on a schedule?
items.a: Yes. Outside lights at dusk, a bright kitchen in the morning, everything off at midnight, set once.
